name: Cisco ASA — High Volume of Failed Inbound Connections from One IP (v2)
alert_name: Cisco ASA — High Volume of Failed Inbound Connections from One IP (v2)
description: One external address opens and immediately loses 50+ inbound TCP connections across 10+ internal ports in 10 minutes - a perimeter sweep. Replaces the 106023 rule, which could never fire: the simulator emits permitted-then-SYN-Timeout teardowns rather than ACL denies, and the ASA parser never sets xdm.observer.action = "Deny" (21,435 rows held only Built/Teardown/null). parse_cisco discards the teardown reason, so this runs in RAW mode and extracts the 5-tuple from _raw_log.
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302014" and _raw_log contains "SYN Timeout"
| alter src_ip   = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "for outside:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/"), 0)
| alter src_port = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "for outside:\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+/(\d+)"), 0)
| alter dst_ip   = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "to inside:(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/"), 0)
| alter dst_port = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "to inside:\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+/(\d+)"), 0)
| filter src_ip != null and dst_ip != null
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count() as failed_conns,
       count_distinct(dst_port) as ports_probed,
       count_distinct(dst_ip) as hosts_probed,
       values(dst_ip) as dst_ips,
       values(dst_port) as dst_ports
       by src_ip, _time
| filter failed_conns >= 50 and ports_probed >= 10
| alter app_proto = "TCP"
| fields src_ip, dst_ips, dst_ports, app_proto, failed_conns, ports_probed, hosts_probed
